assessment_basis: Static review of the repository README and linked feature, architecture or roadmap documentation. Source-level deep audit and CI/test rerun were not performed for this adoption.

evidence.claim: The feature matrix documents read-only inventory, bounded INF/ZIP inspection, Authenticode metadata, compatibility evidence, UDRV validation and local reports.
The workflow is described as local input, bounded parser, evidence record, dry-run report and explicit export.

limitations: Package inspection does not certify drivers or install, load or mutate device state.
No test or CI workflow was re-run during ladder adoption.
next_gate: Exercise the end-to-end inspection/report workflow in the declared Windows CI target.
Add adversarial and fuzz coverage for untrusted PE, INF, ZIP and UDRV inputs.
Keep read-only guarantees explicit and regression-tested across integrations.
